The Harmonic Percolator utilizes a hybrid silicon / germanium transistor design that clips asymmetrically and imparts the signal with an unpredictable, yet musical distortion that resembles an overdriven console, but with more warmth and natural compression. This circuit utilizes a pair of 60’s germanium diodes for a warm and nuanced setting that is true to the original, as well as a more aggressive silicon clipping option and diode bypass option accessible via the 3-position toggle switch. CONTROLS Balance Harmonics Clipping Diode switch (Si / Ge / Bypass) Equipped with internal battery snap and standard 9V DC jack. This product does not require an isolated supply.
